title: E-Waste in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Every electrical device from a Berlin household is free at a BSR recycling yard.** There are **14 yards**, open Monday to Saturday and never on Sunday; Berliner Straße in Wilmersdorf is closed until **14 November 2026**.

**Small devices have a closer door.** A supermarket or drugstore over 800 m² that sells electricals, and any electronics store with 400 m² of them, must take **up to three devices per type** with no side longer than **25 cm**, free and with nothing to buy.
**Vapes go back to the Späti.** Since **1 July 2026** every shop that sells e-cigarettes or heated tobacco devices must take used ones back for free, any brand, whatever its size.
**Batteries go back to any shop that sells batteries.** Tape the poles of lithium cells, and never put a power bank or vape in the yellow bin.
**Big appliances ride along free** with the delivery of a new one, at a BSR Kieztag, or with a booked bulky collection; only old filament and halogen bulbs belong in the grey bin.
**My move:** wipe and sign out of anything with your data on it, pull the batteries, then take the drawer to the shop you already pass this week.
